description: Wait for an existing extraction task_id; returns status and document_ids, not extracted data. completed and partially_completed return successfully; failed and insufficient_credits produce errors. Partial completion is not success for every document. Use fetch_document_result or download_results with the returned document IDs. Defaults to poll_interval 2 seconds and max_poll_attempts 3; SDK backoff and retries mean this is not a strict wall-clock deadline. On polling timeout, call again with the same task_id rather than uploading again. This does not approve documents awaiting human review.

max_poll_attempts.description: Maximum task polling attempts; defaults to 3.

poll_interval.description: Initial polling interval in seconds; defaults to 2. SDK backoff can increase the actual delay.

task_id.description: Remote Suparse task ID, not a local path or document ID.

name: wait_for_task_extraction
title: Wait for Task Extraction
